utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Eli, I heard you're organizing a repair drive—need any help picking up parts or spreading the word around the neighborhood?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, I appreciate you asking, Ira. I've got a list of folks who could use a hand, and if you're good with a wrench, I'd be glad to have you on board.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure, I'm handy enough with tools. Just point me toward the first job and I'll get started.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Leo, you mentioned something about a repair drive? What's the quick version?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Bring busted electronics to my garage Saturday, 10am. We'll fix 'em together.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, I'll try to swing by if I can. Got a couple of old gadgets lying around.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: The repair drive? Are you sure that's necessary?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I just don’t want us to be stuck if something breaks mid-week, you know? It’s a safety net.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A safety net? I get that, but do we really need a whole drive for it?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I think I heard something about that... remind me what it's for again?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It's to gather tools and materials for fixing up the community center after the storm damage.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, right! I've got a spare hammer and some nails somewhere. I'll dig them out.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: So, the repair drive—when did you say it was supposed to start? I want to make sure I've got the time right before I set aside my afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Huh? Oh, the repair drive... I think it's tomorrow, but honestly I can't remember if it's in the morning or the afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let's check the neighborhood bulletin board—I think the details were posted there yesterday.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, sorry I'm late—did I miss anything important for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries at all, Dane! I was just catching up with everyone. We're still waiting on a few folks, so you're right on time.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Good to hear. Has anyone figured out who's bringing the tools yet?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Gus, I heard about the repair drive. Let me know if you need any tools or an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam! I could actually use help organizing the tool shed later. Does Saturday morning work for you?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Saturday morning sounds perfect, Gus. I'll bring my toolbox too, just in case.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help track where the repair drive is scheduled to stop. Do you have specific addresses in mind?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, I was thinking we could start with the corner of Maple and 3rd — that's where a lot of parents gather after drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Good call — that's a high-traffic spot. I'll mark that as our first stop. Any other locations you're considering?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Quinn, have you heard about the repair drive happening this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh yes, I already told half the block about it! Are you planning to bring your old lawnmower?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, that thing's been sitting in my shed for years! I figured if anyone can get it running again, it's the volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Rey, did you finally get that repair drive working again?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Mina, yeah I managed to get it running after a bit of tweaking. Thanks for asking.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good to hear. Did you figure out what was causing the issue in the first place?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Nell, I heard there's a repair drive happening this weekend—I'm definitely planning to bring my old toaster!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, a repair drive? I didn't catch that—what's it all about? I've got a lamp that's been flickering for weeks.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It's a community event where volunteers fix broken items for free—I'm bringing my toaster for sure!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Uli, so glad you stopped by! We're kicking off the repair drive this Saturday — I've got a clipboard full of neighbors ready to lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, right. I'll see if I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Let me know if you need any tools or a specific task — I can pencil you in for whatever suits you best.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Eli, have you heard about the repair drive happening this weekend? I heard they're collecting broken appliances.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, I heard about it. Do they have a specific schedule for drop-offs, or is it just all weekend long?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I think it's Saturday morning until early afternoon, but I'd double-check with the community board—they posted a flyer with all the details.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I'm late—got caught up with something. What's the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, the repair drive! We're meeting at the community center at 10 AM tomorrow to fix up the Smiths' fence. Don't forget your toolbox!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Alright, I'll make sure to bring my toolbox—sorry again for rolling in late, but I'll be there bright and early tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Uli, I heard you’re organizing a repair drive. I could lend a hand with tools if you need.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, hey Rey. That'd be more help than you know. My workbench is pretty bare these days.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I've got a decent set of wrenches and a soldering iron I could bring by.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? Yeah, I think I heard something about that. What's the gist of it again?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It's a portable data recovery device, Bo. The police say it's missing, but I've been watching the comings and goings on our street, and I think I saw someone with a similar-looking case near Mrs. Gable's house last night.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Huh, Mrs. Gable's place? I didn't notice anything, but then again I was probably just focused on getting the trash out on time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Hana! I heard you're organizing that repair drive—count me in to help spread the word around the block.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, that's great, Jules! Just to make sure we're on the same page—are you thinking of flyers, door-knocking, or something else?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I was thinking flyers would work best—I can hand them out when I bump into folks at the community garden or the dog park.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, hey Mara, did you say something about a repair drive? I think I lost track halfway through.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yeah, I mentioned a neighborhood repair drive this Saturday. We're getting together to fix up some bikes and small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: A repair drive, huh? That sounds like a good idea. Where exactly is it happening?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Gus, what's this about a repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Oh, it’s just a neighborhood thing—folks bring in broken stuff and I help fix it up. Got any clunkers you want me to look at?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, that sounds useful! I've got a squeaky lawn mower that's been bugging me. When's the next one?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Leo, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. Let me know if you need a hand with anything—I've got some tools and free time this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, bring your tools Saturday at 10am. We'll be at my garage.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect, I'll be there with my toolbox. See you Saturday at 10.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I just want to make sure we have enough space and time to coordinate everyone's appliance drop-offs—do we have a schedule yet?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have you heard from the neighbors about what they're dropping off?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Not yet, but I think we should set a deadline for them to confirm, so we can plan the pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Cleo, did you hear about the repair drive happening this Saturday? I'm spreading the word—everyone's invited!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I heard a bit about it—are we supposed to bring our own tools, or will there a shared stash?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, there'll be a shared stash, but if you've got a favorite hammer or wrench, feel free to bring it along!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Oren, how's the repair drive coming along? Need any help coordinating the schedule?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive—right, that thing! I keep meaning to check my calendar. If you could give me a hand, I'd really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course! I can help wrangle everyone's availability. Want to meet up this afternoon to hash out a schedule?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Nell, I'm so glad you stopped by—do you have a moment to chat about the community repair drive we're organizing next weekend?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, hi Rosa! I've heard a little bit about it from a few folks—what do you have in mind?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Well, we’re hoping to get neighbors together to fix up small things around the block—broken fences, chipped steps, that sort of thing. I was wondering if you might lend a hand or know anyone with tools who could join?
